title: Trancic Variables
note: Dimension table for the 'Trancic Variables No.' column of Table V (referenced there as trancic_id, an array since a case can carry more than one, e.g. a paṭipada id plus an abhiññā id). Per chapter-5-source.md, one of 16 characteristics (1-16) applicable to or connected with the dhyanic (trance) content of thought. First appears at case 18 (p. 99): the classic four-part paṭipadā (progress) x abhiññā (direct-knowledge) scheme -- 2 progress qualities (painful/pleasant) each paired with 2 knowledge-speed qualities (slow/rapid). Ids 9-14 (p. 106-107) are 3 of the 4 adhipati (dominant conditions -- chanda/viriya/citta; paññā not yet seen) each paired with one of 3 intensity grades (hīna/majjhima/paṇīta -- inferior/medium/superior), applied to the plain kāmāvacara-citta content (id 0) at cases 111/111a/111b. Ids 15-16 (p. 107) are the 'empty'/'aimless' qualifiers of the lokuttara (supramundane) path content (id 12).
